description: Regolith filter that generates translationKeys.generated.json — one JSON object nested by locale — by merging vanilla bedrock-samples translations with pack .lang files, per configured locale.

locales.description: Locale codes to generate a translation map for (e.g. ["en_US", "es_ES"]). Each locale gets its own merged map, nested under its code in the output JSON.

vanillaLangUrlTemplate.description: URL template to fetch each locale's vanilla .lang file from. "{locale}" is replaced with the locale code.

cacheMaxAgeHours.description: How long (in hours) to keep each locale's cached vanilla .lang file before re-fetching.

outputJsonPath.description: Output path for the generated JSON map (locale → key → resolved string), relative to the Regolith temp directory.

langFilesTemplate.description: Pack .lang file path templates to merge on top of vanilla (in order) for each locale. "{locale}" is replaced with the locale code. Relative to the Regolith temp directory. Later files override earlier ones.
